LanguageData.MouseDisaster_RefugeeMassacre.questDescr: questDescription->[sponsorName] claims a temporary Ratkin camp threatens their settlement. They ask you to kill all its residents within 15 days of accepting. There are 2-4 adults and 8-16 Ratkin young aged 0-8, living in wooden huts without turrets or electrical equipment. They have only tribalwear, low-tech melee weapons and wooden short bows. Completion grants 12 goodwill. Downing or capturing residents does not complete the task.
